# 07 · Backend API Reference (v1)

**Base URL:** `https://api.jointlabourers.org/api/v1` (staging: `api-staging…`) · JSON · UTF-8
**Auth:** httpOnly cookies (`jl_at` access, `jl_rt` refresh) · staff routes need a role (see TRD §7).
**Live docs:** Swagger at `/api/v1/docs` (local and staging), generated by FastAPI from the routers. This file is the planning contract.

---

## Conventions

- Money in requests/responses: `{ "amountMinor": "2500000", "currency": "NGN" }`. BigInt is sent as a **string**. The frontend formats with `Intl.NumberFormat`.
- Pagination: `?page=1&pageSize=20` → `{ data: [...], meta: { page, pageSize, total } }`.
- Errors: RFC 7807 → `{ "type": "…/need-over-capacity", "title": "Need has less remaining than requested", "status": 409, "detail": "…", "available": { "amountMinor": "142000", "currency": "NGN" } }`.
- Idempotency: payment-creating `POST`s accept an `Idempotency-Key` header (UUID).
- Public `POST` forms require a `turnstileToken`.

## 1. Auth (`/auth`)

| Method | Path | Body / notes | Access |
|--------|------|--------------|--------|
| POST | `/auth/register` | `{email, password, firstName, lastName?}` | public |
| POST | `/auth/login` | `{email, password, totp?}` → sets cookies | public |
| POST | `/auth/magic-link` | `{email, purpose}` → emails a link | public (rate limited) |
| POST | `/auth/magic-link/consume` | `{token}` → session or scoped token | public |
| POST | `/auth/refresh` | rotates refresh token | cookie |
| POST | `/auth/logout` | | cookie |
| POST | `/auth/2fa/setup` · `/auth/2fa/verify` | TOTP enrolment | staff |
| GET | `/auth/me` | current user + roles | auth |

## 2. Public content

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| GET | `/content/:key` | e.g. `home.hero`, `home.impact`, `give.money_breakdown` |
| GET | `/stats/impact` | `{ missionariesSupported, needsMetThisYear, needsTotalThisYear, prayerHoursCovered, territories }` |
| GET | `/regions` | |
| GET | `/albums` · `/albums/:slug` · `/reports` | gallery |

## 3. Missionaries

| Method | Path | Notes | Access |
|--------|------|-------|--------|
| GET | `/missionaries?region=&page=` | public view: alias, region, bio, photo (null if sensitive), monthly target + raised this month | public |
| GET | `/missionaries/:slug` | + open needs, tier prices | public |
| POST/PATCH | `/admin/missionaries[/:id]` | full record incl. encrypted fields | admin, field |

## 4. Needs (contributory)

| Method | Path | Notes | Access |
|--------|------|-------|--------|
| GET | `/needs?status=open&category=&region=&almostThere=&sort=deadline` | list of NeedCard data | public |
| GET | `/needs/:code` | detail + updates + public contributor list (anonymous masked) | public |
| GET | `/needs/:code/availability` | `{ targetMinor, raisedMinor, reservedMinor, availableMinor, currency, convertedAvailable: {USD:…, GBP:…} }` | public |
| GET | `/needs/fulfilled` | fulfilled needs with final update | public |
| POST | `/admin/needs` | create draft | field, admin |
| PATCH | `/admin/needs/:id` | edit (send `version` for optimistic lock) | field, admin |
| POST | `/admin/needs/:id/transition` | `{action: "submit"\|"approve"\|"reject"\|"pause"\|"resume"\|"extend"\|"close_partial"\|"reallocate"\|"mark_disbursed"\|"cancel", note?, deadlineAt?, disbursedMinor?, proofMediaId?}` | role per action |
| POST | `/admin/needs/:id/updates` | `{title, body, mediaIds[], isFinal}` → notifies contributors | field, admin |
| GET | `/admin/needs/:id/contributors` | full list (+ CSV) | admin, finance, field |

**Example `GET /needs/JLN-0042`**

```json
{
  "code": "JLN-0042",
  "title": "Motorcycle repair for village outreach",
  "category": "TRANSPORT",
  "region": { "name": "Sahel", "slug": "sahel" },
  "missionary": { "publicName": "Brother E.", "slug": "brother-e", "isSensitive": true, "photo": null },
  "targetMinor": "38000000", "raisedMinor": "23600000", "currency": "NGN",
  "contributorCount": 14, "deadlineAt": "2027-01-31T22:59:59Z",
  "status": "PARTIALLY_FUNDED", "percent": 62,
  "updates": [],
  "contributors": [
    { "displayName": "Ada O.", "amountMinor": "2000000", "currency": "NGN" },
    { "displayName": "Anonymous", "amountMinor": "5000", "currency": "USD" }
  ]
}
```

## 5. Giving and payments

| Method | Path | Body / notes | Access |
|--------|------|--------------|--------|
| POST | `/payments/checkout` | `{designation, needId?, missionaryId?, amountMinor, currency, frequency:"once"\|"monthly", tier?, donor:{fullName,email?,phone?,country?}, isAnonymous, note?, teamName?, coverFee, consent, method?}` → `{reference, redirectUrl, provider}` or `409 need-over-capacity` | public |
| GET | `/payments/:reference/status` | `{status, donationReference?, receiptUrl?}` (polled by thank-you page) | public (by ref) |
| POST | `/pledges` | bank transfer: same donor fields + `{needId?, amountMinor, currency}` → `{reference, bankAccount, expiresAt}` | public |
| GET | `/pledges/:reference` | pledge page data | public (by ref) |
| GET | `/give/options` | currencies, presets per currency, tier prices, payment methods per currency, bank accounts | public |
| POST | `/webhooks/paystack` | `x-paystack-signature` HMAC-SHA512 | gateway |
| POST | `/webhooks/flutterwave` | `verif-hash` header | gateway |
| GET | `/manage/recurring` | via magic-link scoped token | token |
| PATCH | `/manage/recurring/:id` | `{amountMinor?}` · `/pause` · `/resume` · `/cancel` | token / partner |
| GET | `/account/donations` · `/account/donations/:ref/receipt.pdf` | | partner |
| GET | `/admin/donations?from=&to=&status=&designation=&q=` (+ `/export.csv`) | | admin, finance |
| GET | `/admin/pledges?status=` | | finance |
| POST | `/admin/reconcile/import` | multipart bank CSV → statement lines + suggested matches | finance |
| POST | `/admin/reconcile/match` | `{statementLineId, pledgeId}` → confirms donation | finance |
| POST | `/admin/donations/manual` | record cash/cheque gift | finance |
| POST | `/admin/donations/:id/refund` | → gateway refund + negative allocation | finance (+ admin approval) |
| GET | `/admin/recurring?status=` | | finance |

**Payment methods by currency**

| Currency | Gateway | Methods |
|----------|---------|---------|
| NGN | Paystack | Card, USSD, Bank transfer (virtual account), recurring card |
| USD, GBP, EUR | Flutterwave (+ domiciliary transfer) | Card, recurring card, bank transfer (manual pledge) |
| CAD, AUD | Flutterwave | Card, recurring card |
| KES | Flutterwave | M-Pesa, Card |

*(Confirm with Flutterwave which currencies JLICI's account is enabled for during onboarding.)*

## 6. Prayer

| GET | `/prayer/hubs` | `[{hub, displayName, timezone, watchStartUtc, watchEndUtc}]` (clock config) | public |
| GET | `/prayer/coverage` | 168 cells `{weekdayUtc, hourUtc, count}` (frontend shifts to local) | public |

| GET/DELETE | `/manage/prayer/commitments[/:id]` | via magic link | token |

| GET | `/prayer/requests?status=published` | wall | public |
| POST | `/prayer/requests` | `{title, body, submitterName?, submitterEmail?, isPublic}` → PENDING | public |

| PATCH | `/admin/prayer/requests/:id` | `{status, testimony?}` moderate / mark answered | prayer, admin |
| PUT | `/admin/prayer/hubs/:hub` | change watch window | admin |
| GET | `/admin/prayer/coverage` | + per-hub stats and gap list | prayer, admin |

## 9. Frontend revalidation hook

Backend → Frontend: `POST https://jointlabourers.org/api/revalidate` with header `x-revalidate-secret` and body `{ "tags": ["need:JLN-0042", "needs:list", "home"] }`.
